scope: returns and refunds local cache wiring

featuresWired.localState: returns and refunds caches are included in /local/state
featuresWired.readEndpoint: GET /ozon/returns reads local returns/refunds cache with type/status/search filters
featuresWired.batchEndpoint: POST /ozon/returns/batch stores local-only return/refund rows for future plugin or verified readonly import
featuresWired.pageRefresh: refresh reads local cache and does not call unverified Ozon return APIs
featuresWired.pageFilters: type tabs and search operate on local cache rows
